title: Grateful Dead Live at Vanderbilt University on 1972-10-21
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD -> DC8; Reworked version of shnID  94453

ai_review.summary: An expertly cleaned‑up soundboard capture of a fall‑1972 show that sounds crystal‑clear, with the band firing on all cylinders.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the remarkable audio restoration – the mix is clean, Phil’s bass sits prominently forward and the overall balance is crisp.  The performance itself is described as locked‑in, high‑energy and creatively inspired, especially Garcia’s lead work.  No specific song issues are noted, making this a universally praised listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Two 5‑star reviews highlight both superb recording quality and an outstanding performance; the consistent praise gives high confidence in a near‑perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cleaned‑up mix with clear separation, Phil’s bass boosted forward, minimal muddiness; reviewers note the restoration is dramatically better than previous versions.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently strong throughout; band stays locked in with tight transitions and sustained momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Creative, engaging lead guitar work praised by reviewers.
band_member_comments.Phil: Booming bass, prominently mixed forward; highlighted as a key element of the sound.
